```{r}

#Create a function to set the condition based on the number in q name
set_cond <- function(x) switch(x, 'control', 'e_9pp', 'e_7pp', 'e_5pp')

create_wide_vars = function(raw_df){
  #dummies for performance on comprehension checks
  raw_df$pass_med_comp = ifelse(raw_df$comp_medical_pat_b == "80%", 1, 0)
  raw_df$pass_gig_comp = ifelse(raw_df$gig_comp_goal_b == "80%", 1, 0)
  
  #dummy for exclusions (excluded if they fail both comprehension checks)
  raw_df$pass_all_comps = ifelse(raw_df$pass_med_comp == 1 & raw_df$pass_gig_comp == 1, 1, 0)
  
  #participant id variable for later on
  raw_df$pid = 1:nrow(raw_df)

  return(raw_df)

}

#Create variables for the long version of the data
create_long_vars = function(long){
  #Create more specific labels for stuff
  long$scenario = substr(long$q_text, 4, nchar(long$q_text) - 4)
  #Ifscenario says this, delete it
  #allotBoxStuf
  #ernalRefer
  long = long[long$scenario != "allotBoxStuf",]
  long = long[long$scenario != "ernalRefer",]
  
  #fix scenario names for public health
  long$scenario = ifelse(long$scenario == "ph_rever", "ph", long$scenario)
  long$scenario = ifelse(long$scenario == "ph_rev", "ph", long$scenario)
  
  
  long$condition_num = extract_numeric(substr(long$q_text, 1, 2))
  
  long$condition = sapply(long$condition_num, set_cond)
  
  #Add counterbalance condition, fix error in pub health naming
  #These counterbalance conditions must be recoded
  #rse -> alo
  #e.1 -> ahi
  long$counterbalance = substr(long$q_text, nchar(long$q_text) - 2, nchar(long$q_text))
  long$counterbalance = ifelse(long$counterbalance == "rse", "alo", long$counterbalance)
  long$counterbalance = ifelse(long$counterbalance == "e.1", "ahi", long$counterbalance)
  
  
  #Get the choice that they make - field 2->3 is usually either the higher av option
  #(in control), or else it is the higher prop decrease option (in other conditions)
  long$choice_num = parse_number(long$q_value)
  
  #Make some other names for it for convenience
  long$choice = ifelse(long$choice_num == 2, "Higher Absolute Value", NA)
  long$choice = ifelse(long$choice_num == 4, "Lower Absolute Value", long$choice)
  
  long$choose_high_av = ifelse(long$choice_num == 2, 1, NA)
  long$choose_high_av = ifelse(long$choice_num == 4, 0, long$choose_high_av)
  
  long$choose_low_av = ifelse(long$choose_high_av == 1, 0,1)
  
  long$choose_low_av_cc = ifelse(long$choose_high_av == 1, -1,1)
    
  #Get rid of all the empty counterbalance conditions
  long = long[!is.na(long$choice_num),]
  
  #Variable for performance in control condition, to use later
  long$pass_control = NA
  long$pass_control = ifelse(long$condition == "control" & long$choose_high_av==1,1,long$pass_control)
  long$pass_control = ifelse(long$condition == "control" & long$choose_high_av==0,0,long$pass_control)
  
  pass_by_id = long %>% group_by(long$pid) %>% summarize(m_pass_control = mean(pass_control, na.rm=T))
  pass_by_id = data.frame(pass_by_id)
  names(pass_by_id) = c("pid", "m_pass_control")
  
  long = merge(long, pass_by_id)
  
  long$pass_all_controls = ifelse(long$m_pass_control == 1, 1, 0)

  return(long)
}



```

Go wide to long, make variables
```{r, results='hide'}
#Add in some variables for exclusions
temp_med = create_wide_vars(raw_medicine)
temp_lay = create_wide_vars(raw_lay)
temp_gig = create_wide_vars(raw_gig)

long_med = temp_med %>% pivot_longer(cols = contains("X"), names_to = "q_text", values_to = "q_value")
long_lay = temp_lay %>% pivot_longer(cols = contains("X"), names_to = "q_text", values_to = "q_value")
long_gig = temp_gig %>% pivot_longer(cols = contains("X"), names_to = "q_text", values_to = "q_value")

long_med = create_long_vars(long_med)
long_lay = create_long_vars(long_lay)
long_gig = create_long_vars(long_gig)

```
Next, we need to make a combined super long dataset, which will let us run our preregistered analysis. It should basically combine all three existing long datasets.
```{r}

#long_med
#long_lay
#long_gig

#Create new variables recording which sample they were from
long_med$sample = "med"
long_lay$sample = "lay"
long_gig$sample = "gig"

#Variables to keep for combined analysis:
keeps = c('pid','pass_med_comp','pass_gig_comp','pass_all_comps','q_text','q_value','scenario','condition_num','condition','counterbalance','choice_num','choice','choose_high_av', 'choose_low_av', 'pass_control','pass_all_controls','m_pass_control', 'sample')

long_med_cut = long_med[,names(long_med) %in% keeps]
long_lay_cut = long_lay[,names(long_lay) %in% keeps]
long_gig_cut = long_gig[,names(long_gig) %in% keeps]


long_merged = rbind(long_med_cut, long_lay_cut)
long_merged = rbind(long_merged, long_gig_cut)

long_merged$merge_pids = paste0(long_merged$pid, long_merged$sample)

long_merged_nox = long_merged
long_merged = long_merged[long_merged$pass_all_comps==1,]

```

## Main statistical test

"To determine if behavior matches the predictions of our theory, our main confirmatory analysis will be a mixed effects linear regression of choice of the lower absolute value option onto a dummy variable indicating if the trial was the control (0) or 9 percentage point experimental trial (1), with a random intercept by participant, with data subset to just the control and 9 percentage point experimental trial. A significant positive coefficient on the trial variable will indicate that participant's actions are in line with our predictions, such that they are more likely to prefer a lower absolute value option if it gives a higher proportional decrease in bad outcomes."


```{r}

#with exclusions
long_merged_c_v_9 = long_merged[long_merged$condition == "control" | long_merged$condition == "e_9pp",]

long_merged_c_v_9$condition_is_9pp = ifelse(long_merged_c_v_9$condition == "e_9pp", 1, 0)

long_merged_c_v_9$condition_is_9pp_cc = ifelse(long_merged_c_v_9$condition == "e_9pp", 1, -1)

main_mod = lmer(choose_low_av ~ condition_is_9pp + (1 | merge_pids), data = long_merged_c_v_9)

summary(main_mod)



#without exclusions
long_merged_c_v_9nx = long_merged_nox[long_merged_nox$condition == "control" | long_merged_nox$condition == "e_9pp",]

long_merged_c_v_9nx$condition_is_9pp = ifelse(long_merged_c_v_9nx$condition == "e_9pp", 1, 0)

long_merged_c_v_9nx$condition_is_9pp_cc = ifelse(long_merged_c_v_9nx$condition == "e_9pp", 1, -1)

main_modnx = lmer(choose_low_av ~ condition_is_9pp + (1 | merge_pids), data = long_merged_c_v_9nx)

summary(main_modnx)


```


##  Statistical Tests of Expertise
